definitions.explanation: A previously owned automobile being resold, as opposed to a brand-new vehicle.

examples.japanese: {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試乗|しじょう}→試乗：08448_shijou⟧してきた。
examples.english: I went for a test drive at a used car dealership.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since a new car is expensive, I decided to look for a used car in good condition.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧ (secondhand; used) and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (car; vehicle). Japan has an especially large and well-organized used car market, with vehicles often in excellent condition due to the country's strict vehicle inspection system (⟦{車検|しゃけん}→車検：18516_shaken⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: used car sales
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧: used car dealership
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: used car market
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a used car
- ⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}: certified pre-owned vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧: new car — the direct opposite
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧: secondhand; used — the general term for any secondhand item, not limited to cars
- ⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧: secondhand goods — broader category covering all used items
